question: Do the causally screened L7 mode split, known L9 pair, and complete MLP7/MLP9 responses compose into a stable writer program on outcome-new temporal and is/was constructions?
authority: Freeze the validated upstream atlas before opening v11 outcomes. Use seven jointly capable A1 and seven A2 rows from each v11 task population, for 28 rows total.
design: Execute all 32 subsets of the five frozen response groups by patching complete donor responses into the base causal prefix and allowing later computation to recompute. This bounded factorial is more informative than greedy selection at five groups: it contains every greedy prefix and exposes serial redundancy and nonlinear interactions.
measurements: Exact pre-L11H3 canonical mode signed projection, cosine, and norm ratio by task and mode.
Final resid18 physical-mode projection and donor-answer/foil behavioral recovery.
Five-way Boolean-lattice Mobius coefficients for pre-H3 mode projection and behavior.
Residual-to-full target for every subset and the improvement of the complete union over the known L9 pair.

predictions.instrument: Authority hashes, capability, shapes, attention replay, base self-patch, finite outputs, 37-forward/1036-example price, and all 32 arms close.
predictions.l7_split_transfer: On v11, L7H7 has greater mode-1/mode-2 selectivity than L7H8 in both tasks, while L7H8 has positive mode-2 cosine and at least 0.05 signed projection in both tasks.
predictions.known_l9_transfer: The L9 pair has positive cosine at least 0.80 and signed projection at least 0.20 for both modes in both tasks.
predictions.distributed_union: The complete five-group union reduces squared pre-H3 residual relative to the L9 pair by at least 10% in at least three of four task-mode cells and has positive behavioral direction on at least 85% of rows.
predictions.bounded_interaction: The complete-union pre-H3 projection differs from the sum of singleton projections by at most 0.35 target units in every task-mode cell; larger interaction rejects a simple additive writer program but remains evidence for a conditional circuit.

decision: Invalid on instrument failure. All predictions yield a stable compositional writer screen. Split plus L9 without union improvement identifies the L7 directions as redundant/serial probes rather than additions. Union improvement with excessive interaction yields a conditional-composition screen. A null kills promotion on these v11 populations without changing groups, rank, or thresholds.
